# اُسْتُمْجِدْنَ (ustumjidna) /us.tum.d͡ʒid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# اِسْتَمْجِدْنَ (istamjidna) /is.tam.d͡ʒid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
